description: This file handles locale name aliases, including reading alias mappings from files, managing alias tables, and providing alias expansion functionality.

methods.name: _nl_expand_alias
methods.description: Expands a locale alias to its full value by searching alias tables and files.

methods.name: read_alias_file
methods.description: Reads alias mappings from a specified file and updates the alias table.

methods.name: extend_alias_table
methods.description: Doubles the size of the alias table when capacity is exceeded.

methods.name: alias_compare
methods.description: Compares two alias map entries case-insensitively.
